result.instructions: Tools for Comgate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which payments are still pending, and which were paid today?"; "Show the status and payer details for payment AB12-CD34-EF56."; "Create a 1,250 CZK payment request for order 445566 and send me the payment link.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Comgate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run comgate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run comgate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run comgate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. comgate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: comgate_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the payment methods this merchant can offer (id, group, name). Use an id as the `method` value when creating a payment. Comgate API: GET /v2.0/method.json.

tools.name: comgate_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment status
tools.description: Get one payment by transId: status (PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED or AUTHORIZED), amount, currency, refId, method, fee and the payer's contact fields. Comgate API: GET /v2.0/payment/transId/{transId}.json.

tools.name: comgate_list_transfers
tools.title: List bank transfers for a date
tools.description: List the bank transfers (payouts to the merchant account) recorded for one date. Use a transferId from the result with comgate_get_transfer. Comgate API: GET /v2.0/transferList/date/{date}.json.

annotations.title: List bank transfers for a date

tools.name: comgate_get_transfer
tools.title: Get a bank transfer
tools.description: Get one bank transfer by transferId: its date, amount and the payments it contains. Comgate API: GET /v2.0/singleTransfer/transferId/{transferId}.json.

tools.name: comgate_create_payment
tools.title: Create a payment request
tools.description: Create a payment that a payer completes on the Comgate page. Returns transId and the redirect URL to send the payer to. Money moves only when the payer pays. Without `test: true` the payment is a live production payment. Comgate API: POST /v2.0/payment.json.

price.description: Amount in the smallest unit (cents or pennies). 1000 = 10.00 CZK.

label.description: Short product description, 1-16 characters. Used to filter payments in the portal.

refId.description: Your order or variable symbol. It does not have to be unique.

fullName.description: Payer's full name, e.g. Josef Novák.

email.description: Payer's email. Give email or phone (or both).

phone.description: Payer's phone in international format, e.g. +420777112233. Give email or phone (or both).

method.description: Payment method id from comgate_list_payment_methods, or ALL to let the payer choose (default ALL).

country.description: Country code limiting the methods, e.g. CZ (default CZ).

lang.description: Payer page language, ISO 639-1, e.g. cs or en (default cs).

test.description: true creates a test payment that no one is charged for. Default: production.

tools.name: comgate_cancel_payment
tools.title: Cancel a pending payment
tools.description: Cancel a payment that is still PENDING (the payer has not paid). A paid payment cannot be cancelled: use comgate_refund_payment. Comgate API: DELETE /v2.0/payment/transId/{transId}.json.

tools.name: comgate_refund_payment
tools.title: Refund a paid payment
tools.description: Refund all or part of a PAID payment. Money goes back to the payer, and the refund cannot be undone. Amount is in the smallest unit (cents or pennies). Comgate API: POST /v2.0/refund.json.

amount.description: Refund amount in cents or pennies. Full or partial refund, at most the paid amount.

refId.description: Your refund reference. It does not have to be unique.

test.description: true runs a test refund that moves no money. Default: production.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Comgate
prompts.description: What you can do with Comgate here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_status_of_a_payment
prompts.title: Check the status of a payment
prompts.description: Read a payment by its transaction id: status, amount, currency, method, fee and the payer's contact fields.

prompts.name: create_a_payment_link_for_an_order
prompts.title: Create a payment link for an order
prompts.description: List the payment methods, then create a payment request for an order. Send the payer the returned link. Money moves only when the payer pays.

prompts.name: cancel_a_payment_the_payer_did_not_complete
prompts.title: Cancel a payment the payer did not complete
prompts.description: Read the payment first. Cancel it only while its status is PENDING. A paid payment cannot be cancelled.

prompts.name: refund_part_of_a_paid_payment
prompts.title: Refund part of a paid payment
prompts.description: Read the payment to confirm it is PAID. Refund all or part of it in the smallest currency unit. The money goes back to the payer, and the refund cannot be undone.

prompts.name: check_which_bank_transfers_were_paid_out_on_a_date
prompts.title: Check which bank transfers were paid out on a date
prompts.description: List the bank transfers paid out to the merchant account on one date. Open a transfer to see the payments it contains.
